Spellshape Universal Spell Bus

Firmware Enhancement During your daily preparations, you can create one temporary spell gem for each rank of spells you can cast, selecting spells in your spell database or spell chips. Any spell gems created this way can't be sold and stop working next time you make your daily preparations.

Overclock Boost(spell chip or spell gem) You can use the overclocked item as if the spell appeared on your spell list as an arcane spell, as long as you could cast a spell of the same rank or lower using your technomancer spell slots.

Overclock Pulse—Overclock Spell Gear 1 (flourish) Requirements You have an overclocked spell chip or spell gem; Effect You use Universal Spell Bus. If your next action is to Cast a Spell from an overclocked item, you can Overclock Gear immediately as a free action after the spell resolves.

Basic Jailbreak (3rd)—Overclock Extension If you Jailbreak Spell to apply Universal Spell Bus to a spell, you can Overclock Gear immediately as a free action after the spell resolves, ignoring the usual restriction from Jailbreak Spell.

Advanced Jailbreak (8th)—Exploding Spell Bus If you Jailbreak Spell to apply Universal Spell Bus to a spell from a spell gem, after the spell resolves, you magically launch the consumed spell gem across the battlefield. You Area Fire the spell gem as a grenade, even if you're not holding it, using the same DC as the spell gem. You treat that spell gem as an electromag grenade with a level equal to or less than the level of the spell gem. This grenade uses your spell DC instead of your class DC. If the spell dealt damage, the damage of the electromag grenade uses one type of damage the spell dealt (your choice) instead of electricity.
